slot.brief: Solve dy/dx = f(y/x) type homogeneous DE with a simple rational f; general solution with a log.

stem: The general solution of $\dfrac{dy}{dx}=1+\dfrac{y}{x}$, for $x\ne0$, is

verdicts.working: Rewrite as y' - y/x = 1. Then (y/x)' = 1/x, so y/x = ln|x| + C and y = x(ln|x| + C).

working:
$y=vx\Rightarrow \dfrac{dy}{dx}=v+x\dfrac{dv}{dx}$\\
$v+x\dfrac{dv}{dx}=1+v\Rightarrow \dfrac{dv}{dx}=\dfrac{1}{x}$\\
$v=\ln|x|+C\Rightarrow y=x(\ln|x|+C)$
